Maximum likelihood estimator of CFU

find_mle.Rd

Maximum likelihood estimator that accounts for saturation of a spot or plate at roughly N countable colonies (a most probable number style estimate).

Usage

find_mle(counts, dil, N = 5000, V = 1)

Arguments

counts

Numeric vector of colony counts.

dil

Numeric vector of dilution factors (e.g. 1e-5), same length as counts.

N

Estimated maximum number of countable colonies, e.g. the area of the plate or spot divided by the average colony size. Defaults to 5000, the value recommended for 100 mm petri dishes (about 50 for a 2 ul spot).

V

Sampling volume. The default of 1 returns absolute CFU in the amount plated or spotted.

Value

A one-row data frame with columns r, stderr and type. If any count exceeds N the estimate is Inf. If all counts are zero the estimate is 0 with an NA standard error.

Examples

find_mle(c(2, 4, 3, 25, 32), c(1e-6, 1e-6, 1e-6, 1e-5, 1e-5), N = 100)
#>         r   stderr         type
#> 1 3308623 408870.9 ML_estimator
